text:
Maya: @here customers reporting a spike of 503s and timeouts to hosted inference in us-west-2 starting ~09:03 UTC. Several support tickets, CS is escalating.
Natalie: seeing 20+ tickets with similar stack: client gets 503 with 'upstream unavailable' and transient keepalive failures. I've attached a repro curl from a customer.
Jenn: repro curl? can you paste the exact command so eng can replay quickly.
Natalie: `curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke -d '{"input":"long prompt"}'` — returns 503 after ~1s.
deploy-bot: deploy noticed at 09:02:14 UTC: rolling canary to gateway pool gwy-usw2-3 succeeded. No automatic rollbacks.
Kai: grabbing live traces from gateway and edge proxies. initial hypothesis: keepalive/TCP splice regressions after recent proxy build.
Owen: I pulled logs from the edge:
```
[09:02:50] conn_id=0x3b2 authz: token validated
[09:02:51] upstream_conn=failed keepalive handshake EPROTO
[09:02:51] gateway: returning 503 UpstreamUnavailable
[09:02:51] backend: no active replica for model 'redwood-3b' on pool gwy-usw2-3
```
Sarah: interesting — backend shows no active replica for that pool. Could be autoscaler misreporting or healthcheck flapping.
ops-oncall: checking autoscaler: all replicas healthy at 09:01, but metrics show abrupt drop in active connections at 09:02. correlating with canary.
Maya: customer impact: several high-usage tenants hitting 5xx; CS is pausing retries on client guidance and offering credits. Need mitigation plan.
Kai: immediate mitigations we can try: 1) disable canary on gwy-usw2-3 (rollback), 2) increase keepalive timeout on proxy to 60s, 3) route traffic away from that pool to alternate pools.
Owen: prepared a quick packet capture showing RST after TLS handshake when reused keepalive socket is pulled — looks like an EPROTO on socket reuse.
Sarah: I'd prefer routing away from the pool and rolling back the canary first to stop new affected requests. rollback is low-risk.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated for canary on gwy-usw2-3 at 09:07:02 UTC. Progress updates will follow.
ops-oncall: routing rule applied at 09:07:20 UTC — 95% of traffic moved off gwy-usw2-3 to gwy-usw2-1/2. P50 error rate for affected tenants dropped from 18% -> 1.2% in 2m.
Natalie: CS update: customers seeing immediate improvement, reducing escalations. Logged comms to ticket threads.
Maya: good. capture action items and owners please.
Kai: action items: A) full proxy build review for keepalive regression — owner: Kai, due EOD. B) autoscaler healthcheck audit for misreporting of replicas — owner: Owen, due tomorrow. C) add a short-circuit fallback to detect pool-wide authz/keepalive handshake failures and route automatically — owner: Sarah, due in 3 days. D) customer comms and credits — owner: Natalie, ongoing.
Owen: I'll attach the packet captures and a `tcpdump` snippet to the incident doc. sample log: `tls_handshake: error=EPROTO socket=7 reuse=true`.
Sarah: postmortem note: we should add chaos tests for keepalive reuse across canary deploys.
ops-oncall: follow-up checklist added to runbook: 1) confirm rollback completed; 2) gather traces + pcap; 3) snapshot autoscaler state; 4) list impacted tenants; 5) draft postmortem.
Maya: leaving this thread open for postmortem updates. tagging for visibility: @Kai @Owen @Sarah @Natalie. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
